chunks.query: Generate an ordered list of every distinct step performed in this video, in order. Include brief steps and steps that are repeated. Write each step as a direct, actionable instruction, as if telling the reader what to do. Do not narrate or describe what is happening in the video. Capture the details needed to repeat the action exactly: control and part names, printed and on-screen text quoted word for word, part numbers, model and serial numbers, tool types and sizes, quantities, and which way things move. For every component being handled, state where it is using grid terms such as top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right, center-left, or upper-center. Where several similar actions are performed, such as four screws on one panel, treat each as its own step and say what distinguishes it. Where the video shows how to tell the step worked, say that. Base every step on what is visible; use the spoken narration where there is any, and rely on the picture alone where the video is silent. Each step must describe a different action from the one before it — where two moments look alike, state what changed between them. Do not invent steps, parts, or details that are not shown or stated in the video.

rows.instruction: Open the trunk of the car.
Remove the spare tire from the trunk.
Take out the jack and lug wrench from the trunk.
Place the spare tire on the ground next to the car.
Position the jack under the car's designated lifting point.
Use the lug wrench to loosen the lug nuts on the wheel.
Continue loosening the lug nuts until they are free.
Remove the lug nuts and set them aside.
Pull the wheel off the car and set it aside.
Mount the spare tire onto the wheel hub.
Hand-tighten the lug nuts onto the spare tire.
Use the lug wrench to fully tighten the lug nuts.
Lower the car using the jack until the spare tire is on the ground.
Remove the jack from under the car.
Store the flat tire and tools back in the trunk.

rows.instruction: Place the scissor jack under the vehicle's designated jacking point near the front wheel.
Use the jack handle to raise the vehicle until the tire is clear of the ground.
Remove the wheel cover from the wheel.
Loosen the wheel nuts using the wrench but do not remove them yet.
Fully remove the wheel nuts and set them aside.
Remove the flat tire from the vehicle.
Mount the spare tire onto the wheel hub.
Hand-tighten the wheel nuts onto the spare tire.
Lower the vehicle completely using the jack.
Tighten the wheel nuts securely with the wrench in a star pattern.
Store the flat tire and tools in the trunk.
Check the spare tire pressure and ensure it is suitable for temporary use.
